pages.text: Altered from $(5)Soul Speed$(), $(4)Cackling Craze$() increases the speed, strength and knockback resistance, as well as decreasing the maximum health of the wearer whenever standing on Remains. Maximum level is $(4)III$() and it conflicts with $(5)Soul Speed$().

pages.title: Notes
pages.text: It is one of the execrations that set the user most in tune with the Risus. Because of this, hearing distant and distorted echoes of laughter is rather common while using it. The speed increase given is weaker than that of Soul Speed, but it more than makes up for it with the strength increase, even with the decrease in vitality. It works exceptionally well with the Proliferation execration.
